**Verdict: don't publish as is.** Two health claims need to come out.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Chamomile and Lemon Balm, "gentle, honeyed", "caffeine-free blend" | Product facts (ingredients, flavour), fine |
| "reduces anxiety" | Unsupported. Health claim, which policy section 3 bans ("reduces anxiety" is listed by name). |
| "helps you sleep" | Unsupported. This is also a health claim. Sleep benefits are regulated territory and would likely trip ad and advertising-standards rules in the UK. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted, exact wording |
| "20 plastic-free tea bags" | "Plastic-free" is allowlisted. The count of 20 is a product fact. Fine. |

No banned voice words, invented stats, superlatives, guarantees or fake urgency. The product page needs no disclosure label.

**Suggested compliant version**

> Chamomile and Lemon Balm. A gentle, honeyed, caffeine-free blend. Certified organic by the Soil Association. 20 plastic-free tea bags.

If you want to say something about when to drink it, describe the taste or ritual (e.g. "a soft, floral cup") rather than any effect on the body. Per the policy, Sam needs to approve this before it goes live.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "reduces anxiety", "type": "health_claim"}, {"quote": "helps you sleep", "type": "health_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
